title: Augmented Situation Awareness: Reducing Cognitive Load in Campus Security via Spatially-Anchored AR Visualization
abstract_snippet: Large-scale campus monitoring systems can quickly generate thousands of alerts in a short time. As these systems detect anomalies, human operators must make sense of these alerts and respond physically. Conventional dashboards often present streams of text or other visual summaries such as markers on a geographic display that require operators to interpret these abstractions into physical location...
